title: Clock
description: House-time clock messages (M4). The backend owns one house-time clock; every service reads it. Real mode runs at wall time; accelerated mode is controlled by the operator (Lab).

speed.description: Requested house seconds per wall second (1 in real mode).

effective_speed.description: Speed actually applied. Lower than speed when the governor slows house time so detection keeps up (data is never dropped); 0 while paused.

episode.description: Increments on every world reset. Readings from different episodes never mix.

episode_start.description: House time at which the current episode began (its reset start). A consumer that joins mid-episode backfills from here.

ClockCommand.title: ClockCommand
ClockCommand.description: Operator change to an accelerated clock. jump_to must not be earlier than the current house time (house time is monotonic; use a reset to start over).

ResetCommand.title: ResetCommand
ResetCommand.description: Operator request to start a new episode: a fresh world at house time 'start'. Clears live state and starts a new store.
